# KovaGPT

> KovaGPT is an AI workspace for conversational drafting, coding help, web-assisted answers, research, and image generation.

Signed-in Free users use Argon Lite normally and Argon Medium with Thinking enabled. Plus includes all seven models in Lite, Medium, High, Extra High and Max. Pro includes all seven models through Ultra. Ultra uses four parallel subagents of the selected foundation. Free offers very limited usage. Plus offers 5× Free usage with limits on all chat models. Pro ($80/month) offers 100× Free usage, or 20× Plus, and unlimited basic Argon Lite chat; advanced model usage is limited. Model availability and usage limits are enforced by the server. Product labels do not imply separately trained model weights. The seven products are Argon 4.6, Neon 4.6, Xenon 5, Argon 4.5, Neon 4.5, Xenon 4.6 and Xenon 6.1. Voice input is not currently part of the supported web product. Search, research, connected apps, and image generation depend on configured providers and account access. Scheduled background work and image editing are not currently available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Chat with KovaGPT, choose an available response mode, and attach supported files.
- [Images](/images): Generate images when an image provider is configured.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Compare Free, Plus, and Pro plans.
- [Apps](/apps): Review the connections currently available to your account.
